simplesect.para: In XSCT/classic flow, DeviceId is used to look up the device configuration.

briefdescription.para: Initializes ECC in BRAM when hardware initialization is not available.

detaileddescription.para: Ensures that ECC in the BRAM is initialized if no hardware initialization is available. The ECC bits are initialized by reading and writing data in the memory. This code is not optimized to only read data in initialized sections of the BRAM.

parameterdescription.para: Reference to a structure containing information about a specific BRAM device.
Device base address in the virtual memory address space.

detaileddescription.para: Initializes the BRAM device and sets up interrupts.

This file contains a design example using the BRAM driver (XBram) in an interrupt driven mode of operation. This example assumes that there is an interrupt controller in the hardware system and the BRAM device is connected to the interrupt controller.
